interventions.name: Map Customer Profile 1 segmen (jobs/pains/gains ranked + concrete)
interventions.expected_evidence: 1 profil satu segmen penuh (banyak stickies) + setiap pain ekstrem punya threshold terukur dari ukuran customer sendiri
interventions.contraindicated_until: Segmen dipilih (who-where pair) — profiling pada segmen kabur = buang waktu

interventions.name: Ad-lib offer + Value Map (relievers/creators ter-mapping ke profile)
interventions.expected_evidence: 1 kalimat offer utuh (ad-lib terisi semua blanko) + setiap reliever/creator memetakan ≥1 pain/gain
interventions.contraindicated_until: Pain/reliever-creator belum termapping dari percakapan nyata — offer dirancang dari dugaan, bukan bukti

interventions.name: Fit check + 10-characteristics assessment
interventions.expected_evidence: Skor assessment 10 karakteristik + daftar karakteristik terlemah + status fit stage (paper/market/bank)
interventions.contraindicated_until: Offer (VP-I02) belum tertulis — menilai fit tanpa offer jelas menghasilkan skor tanpa pembanding

interventions.name: Test-the-circle experiments (test card pada hipotesis risiko tertinggi)
interventions.expected_evidence: ≥3 learning cards filled with measurable evidence on the jobs/pains/gains that matter — BEFORE testing the offer
interventions.contraindicated_until: Customer profile mapped (VP-I01) — without profile, hypothesis cannot be extracted
